workstream: BLU3797 pharmacology, exposure, chemistry, public comparators and bounded patent review
decision: Continue a staged independent proof; no S-tier or development-candidate promotion
main_conclusion: Published evidence supports a potent mouse-active PIK3C2B tool. Released data do not establish sustained selective free-muscle exposure or a quantified neural safety margin.

new_findings.finding: Published BLU3797 PIK3C3 NanoBRET IC50 14,366 nM is not supported by released response cells, all twenty of which are zero. Duplicate Fig1C cells and plotted curve agree with the zero-response dataset.
new_findings.interpretation: Do not substitute a new IC50 or infer a new off-target toxicity. Root independently confirmed.

new_findings.finding: Biochemical IC50 28 nM is near half the nominal final enzyme concentration 60 nM.
new_findings.interpretation: Possible tight-binding/ligand-depletion floor; no Ki derived. Active enzyme fraction or method transcription could differ. Not a falsification of inhibition.

new_findings.finding: Fig6A and S6B contain cross-sectional end-of-study/after-final-dose plasma values without post-dose hours or free-versus-total bioanalysis specification.
new_findings.interpretation: Cannot reconstruct 24h Ctrough, free-muscle exposure, AUC, half-life, clearance, bioavailability or Kp,uu.

new_findings.finding: FBS-corrected NanoBRET thresholds appear only as graphical lines; binding fraction, correction equation and numeric threshold values not supplied in inspected package.
new_findings.interpretation: Do not infer 1% unbound fraction or equate serum correction with mouse-muscle free exposure.

new_findings.finding: Final BLU3797 product 21.7 mg from 0.114 mmol is reported as 38% yield; neutral-MW arithmetic gives approximately44.7% if no purity/form correction.
new_findings.interpretation: Omitted correction, material form or transcription possible; no cause or corrected yield asserted.

new_findings.finding: WO2025003330A1 provides exact distinct-core C2β inhibitor examples47/91. Functional panel favors47;91 has substantial off-target inhibition at10µM despite a clean lysate-kinobead summary.
new_findings.interpretation: 47 is a comparator qualification candidate, not validated human-muscle treatment or rights-free asset.

new_findings.finding: PCT entry is labeled ceased but EP4734987A1/CN121816181A national branches are displayed pending. Actual Formula1 claim is broader than title examples.
new_findings.interpretation: No definitive BLU Markush mapping or FTO conclusion. Official EPO register retrieval403.

new_findings.finding: ClinicalTrials.gov exact-code API search returns0 studies; code/target query returns1 unrelated observational biomarker study.
new_findings.interpretation: No named clinical BLU program located; not proof of abandonment or licensing availability.

program_status.conclusion: No named clinical BLU3797 program located; no abandonment/licensing-availability inference

decision_rules: Continue exact BLU only if authenticated material and qualified engagement support useful post-deficit human muscle function with a relevant injury margin.
Continue target with another exact article if orthogonal catalytic evidence supports function while BLU fails on its own chemistry or distribution.

Reduce target priority if an engaged catalytic intervention fails in a qualified disease model with a demonstrated post-deficit functional positive control, or measured relevant-tissue exposure shows that necessary muscle inhibition cannot be separated from injury. Prior genetic correction alone establishes disease causality, not delayed modifiability; equal-concentration culture overlap alone leaves in-vivo distribution unresolved.
Do not interpret unqualified article/assay/model negatives as target falsification.
